facts.fact: Leah 说 Dustin 上大学时买了辆旧摩托，修好后打算全国骑行。
facts.anchor: He says we’re going to go on a cross-country trip when it’s done.

facts.fact: 车库里 Dustin 与 Colm 站在一辆拆开摊在防水布上的 Indian 摩托旁喝啤酒。
facts.anchor: an Indian motorcycle exploded neatly on a tarp

facts.fact: Dustin 带着醉意说只有拆开东西才能弄明白。
facts.anchor: You only figure things out when you take them apart.

facts.fact: Hattie 说 Ed 卖掉摩托车给她买了她左手上的戒指。
facts.anchor: Sold it to buy me this

facts.fact: Dustin 说作家出现逼他谈 Tommy 时，他曾想杀了他。
facts.anchor: I wanted to kill him when he showed up and forced me to talk about Tommy.

facts.fact: Dustin 告诉 Hattie 他和 Leah 想继续往前过日子，不想再谈那件事。
facts.anchor: Leah and I are trying to move on. We don’t want to talk about it.

facts.fact: Dustin 冲 Hattie 说她没有出庭指证 Tommy，没有嫁给他女友，没有过他的生活。
facts.anchor: You didn’t testify against him. You’re not marrying his girlfriend. You’re not living his life.

facts.fact: Dustin 说她没有在夜里等着他站起来把她的一切夺走。
facts.anchor: You’re not waiting to wake up some night with him standing over you ready to take it all away.
